scope: Read-only review of run.py and summarize.py; no independent training rerun

findings.donor_selection: Random within-actor derangement uses actor and index only; y is used only for array length, never its values. Asserts non-self and same actor.
findings.target_zero: Clears target steps 0:32, features 0:259 including both media, masks and logdt; replaces dt by 0.1; retains constant target-phase and query flags.
findings.selection_order: Selection and checkpoint hash are persisted before load_split(test).
findings.original_checkpoint_replay: Copies old weights and calls forward only; no optimizer, parameter updates or new selection.
findings.same_evaluation_contract: New and old models use the same donor plan and delay conditions.
findings.interpretation: Training distribution, augmentation, donor construction and selection change together; report correctly treats new-old difference as a package effect.
